    • Method Detail

      • withTimeToLive

        public MulticastSocketOptions.Builder withTimeToLive​(Integer timeToLive)
        Sets the multicast time-to-live.

        The value must be between 0 and 255, inclusive.

        Parameters:
        timeToLive - the multicast time-to-live
        Returns:
        this builder
        Throws:
        IllegalArgumentException - if timeToLive is null or outside the range 0 through 255

      • withLoopbackModeDisabled

        public MulticastSocketOptions.Builder withLoopbackModeDisabled​(Boolean disabled)
        Sets whether multicast loopback mode is disabled.

        A value of true disables loopback, while false enables it.

        Parameters:
        disabled - true to disable multicast loopback; false to enable it
        Returns:
        this builder
        Throws:
        IllegalArgumentException - if disabled is null

      • withNetworkInterface

        public MulticastSocketOptions.Builder withNetworkInterface​(NetworkInterface networkInterface)
        Sets the network interface used for multicast communication.

        This typically corresponds to the network interface associated with the configured bind address.

        Parameters:
        networkInterface - the network interface to use
        Returns:
        this builder
        Throws:
        IllegalArgumentException - if networkInterface is null

      • build

        public MulticastSocketOptions build()
        Builds the multicast socket options using the configured settings.

        If reuse address has not been explicitly configured, it defaults to true.

        Overrides:

        Returns:
        the configured multicast socket options
